```
~/Project/GLM/SandboxWorld/Terarria1456/Terraria.WorldBuilding/WorldGenRange.cs

using Newtonsoft.Json;
using Newtonsoft.Json.Converters;
using Terraria.Utilities;

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding;

public class WorldGenRange
{
	public enum ScalingMode
	{
		None,
		WorldArea,
		WorldWidth
	}

	public static readonly WorldGenRange Empty = new WorldGenRange(0, 0);

	[JsonProperty("Min")]
	public readonly int Minimum;

	[JsonProperty("Max")]
	public readonly int Maximum;

	[JsonProperty]
	[JsonConverter(typeof(StringEnumConverter))]
	public readonly ScalingMode ScaleWith;

	public int ScaledMinimum => ScaleValue(Minimum);

	public int ScaledMaximum => ScaleValue(Maximum);

	public WorldGenRange(int minimum, int maximum)
	{
		Minimum = minimum;
		Maximum = maximum;
	}

	public int GetRandom(UnifiedRandom random)
	{
		return random.Next(ScaledMinimum, ScaledMaximum + 1);
	}

	private int ScaleValue(int value)
	{
		double num = 1.0;
		switch (ScaleWith)
		{
		case ScalingMode.WorldArea:
			num = (double)(Main.maxTilesX * Main.maxTilesY) / 5040000.0;
			break;
		case ScalingMode.WorldWidth:
			num = (double)Main.maxTilesX / 4200.0;
			break;
		case ScalingMode.None:
			num = 1.0;
			break;
		}
		return (int)(num * (double)value);
	}
}
```

```
export class RNG {
  private ur: UnifiedRandom;
  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  next(): number {
    return this.ur.nextDouble();
  }

  /** 闭区间 [min, max]，≡ 原版 Next(min, max+1) */
  int(min: number, max: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(min, max + 1);
  }

  range(min: number, max: number): number {
    return min + this.ur.nextDouble() * (max - min);
  }

  chance(p: number): boolean {
    return this.ur.nextDouble() < p;
  }

  pick<T>(arr: T[]): T {
    return arr[this.ur.nextInt(arr.length)];
  }

  /** 原版裸方法直通（Reset 序列/pass 级对账用，语义与 C# 完全一致） */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextInt(maxValue);
  }

  /** RunPass 种子重播（1456 WorldGenerator.cs:497：每个 GenPass 执行前
   *  `Main.rand = new UnifiedRandom(_seed)`，IL 实证 newobj+stsfld Main::rand；
   *  GenBase._random => genRand => Main.rand ⇒ 各 pass 掷骰流均从 stream(seed)
   *  第 0 掷开始，pass 间不续流）。原地重置内部流，保持对象引用——ctx.rng 与
   *  闭包捕获在重播后仍然有效。 */
  reseed(seed: number): void {
    this.ur = new UnifiedRandom(seed);
  }

  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    return this.ur.nextIntRange(minValue, maxValue);
  }

  get vanilla(): UnifiedRandom {
    return this.ur;
  }
}
```

```
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Halls;
using Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.Rooms;
using Terraria.Localization;
using Terraria.Utilities;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation.Dungeon.LayoutProviders;

public class LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider : DungeonLayoutProvider
{
	public LegacyDungeonLayoutProvider(DungeonLayoutProviderSettings settings)
		: base(settings)
	{
	}

	public override void ProvideLayout(DungeonData data, GenerationProgress progress, UnifiedRandom genRand, ref int roomDelay)
	{
		LegacyDungeonLayoutProviderSettings obj = (LegacyDungeonLayoutProviderSettings)settings;
		int steps = obj.Steps;
		int maxSteps = obj.MaxSteps;
		LegacyDungeonLayout(data, progress, genRand, settings.StyleData.BrickTileType, settings.StyleData.BrickCrackedTileType, settings.StyleData.BrickWallType, steps, maxSteps, ref roomDelay);
	}

	public void LegacyDungeonLayout(DungeonData data, GenerationProgress progress, UnifiedRandom genRand, ushort tileType, ushort crackedTileType, ushort wallType, int steps, int maxSteps, ref int roomDelay)
	{
		if (data.genVars.preGenDungeonEntranceSettings.PrecalculateEntrancePosition)
		{
			data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX = -10 + (int)data.genVars.dungeonEntrancePosition.X + genRand.Next(20);
			data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY = (int)data.genVars.dungeonEntrancePosition.Y + 30;
		}
		data.outerProgressionBounds = new DungeonBounds[1];
		data.outerProgressionBounds[0] = data.genVars.outerPotentialDungeonBounds;
		LegacyDungeonHallSettings legacyDungeonHallSettings = new LegacyDungeonHallSettings
		{
			StyleData = data.genVars.dungeonStyle,
			RandomSeed = genRand.Next()
		};
		LegacyDungeonRoomSettings legacyDungeonRoomSettings = new LegacyDungeonRoomSettings
		{
			StyleData = data.genVars.dungeonStyle,
			RandomSeed = genRand.Next()
		};
		DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetRoom(new LegacyDungeonRoomSettings
		{
			StyleData = data.genVars.dungeonStyle,
			StartingRoom = true,
			RandomSeed = genRand.Next(),
			RoomPosition = new Point(data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY)
		}).GenerateRoom(data);
		while (steps > 0)
		{
			data.dungeonBounds.UpdateBounds(data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
			steps--;
			int num = (maxSteps - steps) / maxSteps * 60;
			DungeonUtils.UpdateDungeonProgress(progress, (float)num / 100f, Language.GetTextValue("WorldGeneration.DungeonRoomsAndHalls"));
			if (roomDelay > 0)
			{
				roomDelay--;
			}
			if ((roomDelay == 0) & (genRand.Next(3) == 0))
			{
				roomDelay = 5;
				if (genRand.Next(2) == 0)
				{
					int generatingDungeonPositionX = data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX;
					int generatingDungeonPositionY = data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY;
					legacyDungeonHallSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
					DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetHall_Legacy(legacyDungeonHallSettings).GenerateHall(data, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
					if (genRand.Next(2) == 0)
					{
						legacyDungeonHallSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
						DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetHall_Legacy(legacyDungeonHallSettings).GenerateHall(data, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
					}
					legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
					legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RoomPosition = new Point(data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
					DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetRoom(legacyDungeonRoomSettings).GenerateRoom(data);
					data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX = generatingDungeonPositionX;
					data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY = generatingDungeonPositionY;
				}
				else
				{
					legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
					legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RoomPosition = new Point(data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
					DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetRoom(legacyDungeonRoomSettings).GenerateRoom(data);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				legacyDungeonHallSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
				DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetHall_Legacy(legacyDungeonHallSettings).GenerateHall(data, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
			}
		}
		legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RandomSeed = genRand.Next();
		legacyDungeonRoomSettings.RoomPosition = new Point(data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionX, data.genVars.generatingDungeonPositionY);
		DungeonCrawler.MakeDungeon_GetRoom(legacyDungeonRoomSettings).GenerateRoom(data);
		data.outerProgressionBounds[0] = data.dungeonBounds;
	}
}
```

````
The oracle's DBnd clamps to **4200×1200** (small world dims)! For the medium world, every bounds coordinate is clamped to [10, 1190] — that's why B=1190 (= 1200-10)! The L/T/R coincidentally match because the dungeon for this seed sits within x∈[943,1666] ⊂ [10,4190] and T=292 ≥ 10 — all in range. Only B=1520 > 1190 got clamped!

- Make W/H static fields accessible: since the oracle is a top-level program, `W`/`H` are locals. I can add static mutable fields: `static int GW = 4200, GH = 1200;` at the class level... top-level statements can't declare static fields, but I can put them in a helper class or make Cx/Cy non-static using a global holder. ```csharp
static class DgWorld { public static int W = 4200, public static int H = 1200; }
````

```
/** WorldGen.SolidTile（cs:42370）：nactive && solid && !solidTop && !半砖 && 无坡 */
function solidTileHF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  return !!d && !!d.solid && !d.platform && !st.half[i] && st.slope[i] === 0;
}

/** WorldGen.SolidTile2（Place3x2 底检）：nactive && tileSolid（无坡/半砖门） */
function solidTile2HF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  return !!d && !!d.solid && !d.platform;
}

/** 家具放置——PlaceTile 各 helper 1:1（2026-08-17 终清,替代旧 placeHF 近似：
 *  旧版把 Place3x2 逐列底检简化为中央列、床/浴缸 direction 镜像帧未分、
 *  挂画锚点几何近似——act/typ 差 ~127 格 + 挂画环掷流 +277 的根因)。 */
const inB5 = (st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean =>
  x >= 5 && x <= st.w - 5 && y >= 5 && y <= st.h - 5;

/** Place3x2（cs:52097）：桌14/钢琴87/梳妆台88/长凳89。x-1..x+1 × y-1..y 净空
 *  + 逐列 SolidTile2(y+1)；frameX=54*style+col*18,frameY=row*18。
 *  梳妆台 88 的 Chest.CreateChest(x-1,y-1)（:52169-52177）：**在 flag2 终判之前**
 *  无条件调用——失败尝试也烧一个注册表槽（孤儿条目,终态 .wld chests 段保留）；
 *  同位已有条目（FindEmptyChest -1）→ 放置失败。TTTT 2026-08-19 接线
 *  （此前"恒成功不登记"=纯登记债:sink 缺 2 条地狱梳妆台,DeadMans 候选不受影响
 *  ——type 88 过不了 IsAGoodSpot 的 21 门,零掷）。 */
function place3x2HF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, tile: number, style: number, chests?: import('./BuriedChestsPass').ChestSink): boolean {
  if (!inB5(st, x, y)) return false;
  let ok = true;
  for (let i = x - 1; i < x + 2; i++) {
    for (let j = y - 1; j < y + 1; j++) {
      if (st.flags[st.idx(i, j)]) ok = false;
    }
    if (!solidTile2HF(st, i, y + 1)) ok = false;
  }
  if (tile === T_DRESSER && chests) {
    // CreateChest(x-1,y-1)：同位重条目 → flag2=false（放置失败,条目不建）
    if (chests.some(c => c.x === x - 1 && c.y === y - 1)) return false;
    chests.push({ x: x - 1, y: y - 1, items: [], locked: false });
  }
  if (!ok) return false;
  const fx = 54 * style;
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (let j = 0; j < 2; j++)
    st.setTileSilent(x - 1 + i, y - 1 + j, tile, fx + i * 18, j * 18);
  return true;
}

/** Place2x1（cs:47371,工作台 18）：x..x+1 × y 净空 + SolidTile2 两列(y+1)；
 *  frameX=36*style+col*18,frameY=0。 */
function place2x1HF(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, tile: number, style: number): boolean {
  if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] || st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]) return false;
  if (!solidTile2HF(st, x, y + 1) || !solidTile2HF(st, x + 1, y + 1)) return false;
  const fx = 36 * style;
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, tile, fx, 0);
  st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, tile, fx + 18, 0);
  return true;

```
